name: std/text
description: Rich text model and Unicode text utilities: the Texts piece-list model, TextUtilities (load/store/convert), UTF-8 helpers.
residual: The modules under `graphical` belong to this package but cannot travel in the headless SDK: their own import closure reaches the window system. The list is checked against the import graph by docker/gen-headless-core.sh, so it cannot go quietly out of date.

Created to satisfy std/compiler / std/net / std/media requires. The question this line used to ask -- whether Texts/TextUtilities stay runtime-only -- is answered: they do not, both reach WMEvents, which is why they are under `graphical`. UTF8Strings is the only member the headless SDK carries.
